description: This file contains implementation of big number (BIGNUM) shift operations and bit manipulation functions, part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: BN_lshift
methods.description: Performs left shift on a big number by n bits.

methods.name: BN_lshift1
methods.description: Performs left shift by 1 bit on a big number.

methods.name: BN_rshift
methods.description: Performs right shift on a big number by n bits.

methods.name: bn_rshift_secret_shift
methods.description: Performs a secret (constant-time) right shift by n bits.

methods.name: BN_rshift1
methods.description: Performs right shift by 1 bit on a big number.

methods.name: BN_set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a big number.

methods.name: BN_clear_bit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a big number.

methods.name: BN_is_bit_set
methods.description: Checks if a specific bit is set in a big number.

methods.name: BN_mask_bits
methods.description: Masks bits above n in a big number.

methods.name: BN_count_low_zero_bits
methods.description: Counts the number of low zero bits in a big number.
